signal.headline: SGD rates expected to ease before quarter end

whyClient: SGD 380,000 fixed deposit maturing in 12 days — currently his only rate-locked instrument.
whyNow: The desk expects SGD rates to ease before the renewal date. Left alone, the deposit rolls over automatically at whatever rate applies on 2026-09-26.
whyInstrument: A short-tenor structured deposit locks today's rate ahead of the move, without extending duration.

signal.headline: Foundry-segment guidance cut ~8% across peer set

whyClient: 42% of her portfolio sits in one foundry-segment name — well past the 30% concentration threshold for her mandate.
whyNow: A sector-wide guidance cut published this morning directly touches the held name; relevance to this conversation decays fast as the news ages.
whyInstrument: A discretionary-mandate rebalance conversation, not a sale recommendation — the point is to discuss the concentration, not to pitch a product.

signal.headline: SGD rates expected to ease before quarter end

whyClient: SGD 250,000 corporate bond maturing in 17 days.
whyNow: Same rate move as above: reinvesting after the move, rather than before, risks a lower running yield on the replacement instrument.
whyInstrument: A comparable-tenor bond, reinvested ahead of the rate move.

signal.headline: No external signal — internally triggered by an idle-cash threshold

whyClient: SGD 620,000 has sat uninvested for 56 days, past the 45-day idle-cash threshold for her segment.
whyNow: The cash arrived from a property sale in July and has not yet been reviewed against her stated objectives.
whyInstrument: An income-oriented fund conversation, sized to how much of the balance she actually wants deployed.

signal.headline: No external signal — internally triggered by an income-objective gap

whyClient: Trailing portfolio income of SGD 21,400/yr sits 29% below his stated objective of SGD 30,000/yr.
whyNow: The gap has held for a full quarterly review cycle without being raised.
whyInstrument: A higher-income reallocation, discussed against the objective he set — not a yield-chasing pitch.

signal.headline: Pending corporate action on a held name

whyClient: SGD 890,000 held in a company that is the subject of a pending corporate action.
whyNow: The action was announced this morning.
whyInstrument: Would ordinarily be a portfolio conversation.

gateOverride.reason: Client's immediate family holds a board seat at the counterparty, and OCBC's advisory desk is engaged on this transaction. An information barrier is in effect (ref. IB-2026-0091) until the deal is announced publicly or terminated.

signal.headline: Contractual maturity date, no external signal

whyClient: SGD 410,000 fixed deposit maturing in 6 days.
whyInstrument: Would ordinarily be a straightforward renewal conversation.

gateOverride.reason: Suitability review lapsed 2026-05-02 — 4 months past the 12-month refresh policy. No product conversation may proceed until the review is refreshed.

signal.headline: Policy bonus declaration affecting surrender value

whyClient: A bonus declaration on her Great Eastern policy affects its surrender value.
whyNow: The declaration was booked to the policy record this morning.
whyInstrument: Would ordinarily be a policy-review conversation.

gateOverride.reason: This detail originates from a Great Eastern policy record. Cross-entity data-sharing consent for this client is not on file with OCBC Bank, so the specific figure may not cross the One Group perimeter to this RM until consent is obtained.
